items.period: Seal-script style; modern vector rendering of a Shuowen-style form

items.caption: A modern redraw of the seal-script form associated with 體 in Shuowen-style character references; use it to illustrate the received lexicographic form, not as an artifact image.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style glyph for 體 on a white square.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the character and links its original SVG; the form illustrates Shuowen’s received 體 graph. The file is a modern redraw, so it should not be presented as an excavated ancient witness.
items.rights: The Commons page marks the ancient-script vector as public domain.
